_doc: The input sets of the crown run (e2e/crown/README.md): where each set lives on the Volume ferrata-crown, the LEZ side its bundle carries, and the R0BF programs by role (file name in <dir>/programs/, image id: docs/image-ids.md). `setup --inputs NAME` uploads one set and leaves the others untouched; a run records its set in run.json ("inputs"; a run without it is rc1, crown-live-1 to -3); ctl.py, drive.py and verify.py read this file.
